retention_days_warning.name: DLC warning threshold (days)
retention_days_warning.description: Number of days before expiry at which a lot is marked as 'Soon expiring' (yellow). Default: 30.

retention_days_critical.name: DLC critical threshold (days)
retention_days_critical.description: Number of days before expiry at which a lot is marked as 'Urgent' (red). Default: 14.
